MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The metric bolts connect to my recent metric screw and nut assortment, so their fastening purpose feels relevant.",
    "That connection is only tentative: I would still skip them unless I needed the specific M6 size and countersunk head."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wiring connectors and multimeter leads assume an electrical project that my screw assortment purchase does not establish.",
    "A caliper attachment, bench wheel brush, and valve lockout each require a specific task or equipment need I have not shown.",
    "Chair wheels, jewelry cleaner, electrode gel, and seal tape do not address the fastening and magnetic hanging needs reflected in my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or maintenance supply.",
    "The mention of electronics in my screw assortment seems to have been stretched into interest in wiring and electrical testing."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Two recent purchases were magnetic hooks, which gives a clearer indication of interest in magnetic hanging supplies than in unrelated tools.",
    "My recent fasteners were assortments; a pack of one bolt size is only useful if its dimensions and head type fit a particular job.",
    "I rarely interact without a clear practical need, so a loose connection to hardware is not enough for me to choose something."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in fasteners but stretched it into unrelated equipment without a clear use for me."
}
